idleSub: Eqa ukuze uthathe okuhle futhi weqe okubi.
pausedSub: Chofoza noma ucindezele u-Enter ukuze uqhubeke ugijima.
emptySub: Engeza okuqukethwe kulo mdlalo ukuze udlalwe.
copyFail: Umbhalo ukhethiwe. Wukopishe nge-Ctrl noma i-Cmd + C.
stageLabel: Umdlalo wokugijima. Isiqephu sigijima sodwa. Eqa ukuze uthathe imiqondo emihle futhi ugweme emibi.
stageHow: Cindezela u-Space, u-Enter, umcibisholo ophezulu noma u-W ukuze weqe. Cindezela u-Escape ukuze umise. Cindezela u-Tab ukuze uqhubekele phambili. Konke okusemdlalweni kuhlanganisiwe futhi ngaphansi kokuthi Funda ungadlali.
hintKeys: U-Space, umcibisholo ophezulu noma u-W ukuze weqe
guideText: Thatha okuyingxenye yenkomba yezingxenye zewebhu. Eqa okungewona ewebhu yemvelo.
